lines: In temple or in outcaste hut, wits lost though, leave the flesh —
free the same hour as wisdom, alone, with sorrow slain.
sanskrit_cite: tīrthe śvapacagṛhe vā naṣṭasmṛtir api parityajan deham | jñānasamakālamuktaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti hataśokaḥ

lines: What use are pilgrim roads for merit, or outcaste deaths for hell —
when merit's stain and sin's have never touched at all?
sanskrit_cite: puṇyāya tīrthasevā nirayāya śvapacasadananidhanagatiḥ | puṇyāpuṇyakalaṅkasparśābhāve tu kiṃ tena

lines: Lay the clean grain back among the husk —
it will not grow together with its shape again.
So wisdom stripped of veils abides here by old grace —
standing, though it stands, untouched by all it touches.
sanskrit_cite: tadvat kañcukapaṭalīpṛthakkṛtā saṃvid atra saṃskārāt | tiṣṭhanty api muktātmā tatsparśavivarjitā bhavati

lines: As the best-cut gem, though boxed and seeming stained —
shows clear and true when cut free from its case.
sanskrit_cite: kuśalatamaśilpikalpitavimalībhāvaḥ samudgakopādheḥ | malino 'pi maṇir upādher vicchede svacchaparamārthaḥ

lines: So taught by a true teacher into stainless rest —
feeling the body's tether, freed of every other, shines as Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sadguruśāsanavimalasthiti vedanaṃ tanūpādheḥ | muktam apy upādhyantaraśūnyam ivābhāti śivarūpam

lines: On scripture's word, by steady faith grown into that —
he got there first, past heaven and hell and human birth.
sanskrit_cite: śāstrādiprāmāṇyād avicalitaśraddhayāpi tanmayatām | prāptaḥ sa eva pūrvaṃ svargaṃ narakaṃ manuṣyatvam

lines: The final hour may feed a state of good or ill —
a helper, not the cause of going on.
sanskrit_cite: antyaḥ kṣaṇas tu tasmin puṇyāṃ pāpāṃ ca vā sthitiṃ puṣyan | mūḍhānāṃ sahakārībhāvaṃ gacchati gatau tu na sa hetuḥ

lines: Who knows himself as that, be he beast or bird or snake —
sealed long ago by waking, goes the way he goes.
sanskrit_cite: ye 'pi tadātmatvena viduḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpādayaḥ svagatim | te 'pi purātanasaṃbodhasaṃskṛtās tāṃ gatiṃ yānti
